name: Amateur Demolitionist
text: When you play me, play a Bomb gear token to a battlefield. (It has DEPLOY. When it dies, deal 2 to an enemy there and kill your other Bombs there.)
lore: A Bandle City yordle with more enthusiasm than caution. Explosives-loving yordles are a Runeterra staple; Ziggs, the Hexplosives Expert, is the best-known example (wiki: he turned a failed demo into prison-breaking hexplosives).
translation: A cheap body that leaves a Bomb behind. The Bomb is a trap: if it dies it hits an enemy there for 2 and clears your other Bombs. Best in Bomb decks and with Ziggs.

name: Banner of Conquest
text: DEPLOY (Play this only to a battlefield. When an opponent holds here, kill this.) Friendly units here have ASSAULT. (+1 might while they're attackers.)
lore: The flavor text names Noxus ("When Noxus raises a banner, there will be blood before it lowers"). Noxus is the empire that grows by conquest, which is exactly what this banner rewards.
translation: A battlefield gear that gives every friendly unit there Assault, so your attackers hit +1 harder. It dies if the opponent holds the spot, so pair it with units that can defend it.

name: Bilgewater Tracker
text: When you play me, deal 1 to each of up to 2 units.
lore: Bilgewater is a port city built on bounties and salvage; the flavor text jokes about checking the bounty board. No named champion appears on the card.
translation: A 3-power body that pings two units for 1 when it enters. Good for finishing damaged units or clearing 1-health tokens such as Recruits.

name: Lingering Animus
text: I enter ready if a friendly unit or gear died this turn.
lore: The Shadow Isles are cursed by the Ruination, where the dead linger as restless spirits. The flavor text (a drop of blood, a piercing shriek) matches that haunting.
translation: A 2/2 that can attack right away if something of yours died this turn. Rewards decks that trade units or lose Bombs and Deploy gear.

name: Scorched Earth
text: ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Deal 5 damage split among units at a single battlefield.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Five damage divided however you like among units at one battlefield. Strong against a wide board of small units and Recruit tokens.

name: Rally for War
text: Choose an occupied enemy battlefield. Play three 1 might Recruit unit tokens there.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Puts three 1-power Recruits on a contested battlefield. Feeds Assault, Banner of Conquest and any 'when I conquer' effects.

name: War Scout
text: ACCELERATE (You may pay 1 Fury as an additional cost to have me enter ready.) When you play me, give a unit +2 might this turn.
lore: A yordle in Demacian service. Poppy is the best-known Demacian yordle: wiki says she is from Bandle City and settled in Demacia with her mentor Orlon.
translation: Pay extra to enter ready and give a unit +2 might for the turn. A flexible tempo play that can win a combat the turn it lands.

name: Blossoming Dreamroot
text: DEPLOY (Play this only to a battlefield. When an opponent holds here, kill this.) When you win a combat here, draw 1.
lore: The art shows a glowing tree with drifting wisps, in the spirit of the Dreaming Tree that Ivern and Lillia tend in Ionia. The card names no champion, so this is an art-based reading.
translation: A battlefield gear that draws a card whenever you win a combat at its location. Pairs with units that fight well there.

name: Consult the Heavens
text: REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Give a unit SHIELD 2 this turn. (+2 might while it's a defender.) PREDICT (Look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: A cheap trick: +2 defense and a free look at your top card. Good in Shield decks and K'Sante builds.

name: Entrenched Boar
text: You may have me enter ready. If you do, I can't move this turn.
lore: Freljord's wildlife is as dangerous as its tribes; the flavor text jokes that locals fear the pig.
translation: A 2/2 that can enter ready to hold a battlefield right away, at the cost of not moving that turn.

name: Iridescent Avian
text: BUFF a unit. If it's already buffed, give it +2 might this turn instead. (To buff a unit, give it a +1 might buff if it doesn't have one.)
lore: Ixtal is the jungle realm of elemental magic in Shurima's east, known for its birds and beasts.
translation: A 3/3 body that buffs a unit, or gives +2 this turn if it is already buffed. Fits Buff and Mighty decks.

name: Ki Burst
text: ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) As an additional cost to play this, exhaust a friendly unit. STUN a unit. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
lore: The flavor line "For those who were lost." is attributed to Riven. Wiki: after a chemical attack in Ionia killed her comrades, she broke her blade and went into exile.
translation: Exhaust one of your units to stun a unit, which stops its combat damage this turn. Pairs with ready effects such as Hunker Down.

name: Life from Stone
text: REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) As an additional cost to play this, exhaust a friendly unit. Draw 1 and channel 1 rune exhausted.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Exhaust a unit to draw a card and channel a rune. A ramp-and-draw trick that works at any time.

name: Stoic Ferryman
text: SHIELD 3 (+3 might while I'm a defender.) When you play me to a battlefield, you may move another unit you control here to your base.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: A sturdy defender: Shield 3 makes it 5 might on defense. It can also pull one of your units out of a fight back to base.

name: Hunker Down
text: REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Ready a friendly unit. It can't move this turn. Draw 1.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Ready one of your units to defend, then draw a card. Pairs with exhaust costs such as Ki Burst and Life from Stone.

name: Invigorating Bloom
text: When you play this, give a friendly unit +3 might this turn. Exhaust a friendly MIGHTY unit, exhaust: Draw 1. (A unit is Mighty while it has 5+ might.)
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: A pump on play that also becomes a card-draw engine for Mighty units. Great with Buff and Shield packages.

name: Storm Raptor
text: DEFLECT (Opponents must pay 1 to choose me with a spell or ability.) When a stunned enemy unit here dies, draw 1.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: A 6/6 flier with Deflect, so spells that target it cost the opponent extra. It draws when a stunned enemy dies, which pairs with Stun effects.

name: Watchful Curator
text: Your gear have DEFLECT. (Opponents must pay 1 to choose each with a spell or ability.)
lore: Piltover is the city of progress and trade, where relics and rare machines are collected and sold. No named champion appears.
translation: Protects your gear from targeted removal by making opponents pay extra. A natural fit in Gear and Deploy decks.

name: Fanfare
text: The next three times you play a unit this turn, draw 1.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Draw up to three cards if you can play three units in one turn. Best in cheap-unit and Recruit-token decks.

name: High Note
text: REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Give a unit -1 might this turn equal to the number of exhausted units you control. "This one's for you!" -Seraphine
lore: Quoted by Seraphine. Wiki: she was born in Piltover, can hear the souls of others, and turns that overload of voices into music.
translation: The more of your units are exhausted, the bigger the might penalty you can put on one enemy. Fits Seraphine and exhaust decks.

name: Industrious Mechsmith
text: When you play me, play a 3 might Mech unit token here.
lore: Zaun's undercity is full of inventors and tinkerers whose scrap-built machines keep the Sump running. No named champion appears.
translation: A 1-power body that makes a 3-power Mech token at the same battlefield. Strong with Mech payoffs.

name: Mysterious Chronomancer
text: When you play me, PREDICT 2. (Look at the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. Recycle any of them and put the rest back in any order.) DISARM 2 (When I attack, give an enemy unit here -2 might this turn.)
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Sets up your next two draws, then weakens an enemy by 2 when it attacks. A card-quality body for Predict decks.

name: Parallel Convergence
text: As an additional cost to play this, return a friendly unit to its owner's hand. Deal 5 to a unit at a battlefield. "Last chance to be anywhere else." -Ekko
lore: Quoted by Ekko. Wiki: his Z-Drive is a hextech device that can "rewind time to a limit of four seconds" and was built to explore the branching possibilities of reality.
translation: Return one of your units to hand to deal 5 to any unit at a battlefield. Replay units with enter effects such as Amateur Demolitionist.

name: Clanging Sentry
text: Your Mechs have DISARM. (When each of us attacks, give an enemy unit there -1 might this turn.)
lore: The flavor line plays on Piltover's Enforcers keeping order in the city. Mechs are a Piltover/Zaun tech theme; no champion is named.
translation: Every Mech you control gets Disarm, shrinking an enemy when your Mechs attack. A Mech-deck core piece.

name: Improvised Projectile
text: ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Choose a friendly gear. Deal damage equal to its Energy cost to a unit at a battlefield.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Turns a friendly gear's cost into damage. Needs a gear on board, so it fits Gear decks.

name: Piltovan Guidebot
text: When you play a card, you may have my base Might become equal to that card's Energy cost this turn.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: A Mech that grows to match the cost of whatever you play. Play expensive cards to make it huge for the turn.

name: Riptide Mage
text: ACCELERATE (You may pay 1 Mind as an additional cost to have me enter ready.) When you play me, give an enemy unit -3 might this turn.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Enters ready and weakens an enemy unit by 3 might. Good for winning a fight the turn it arrives.

name: Supernova
text: Deal 10 to a unit. Draw 2.
lore: No named champion, but the cosmic imagery echoes Aurelion Sol, the star-forging dragon. This is an art-based reading, not confirmed by the card.
translation: A 9-cost finisher that kills almost anything and draws two. Needs ramp to cast on time.

name: Overloaded Traveler
text: While there's a friendly gear with DEPLOY at my battlefield, I have +1 might. "Bandle Scout Rule 321: If your backpack's not bursting, there's more you can bring!"
lore: The flavor text cites the Bandle Scout Rules. Wiki: the Bandle Scouts are adventurous yordles led by Teemo, the Swift Scout, who adds rules to the Bandle Scout Handbook.
translation: A 2/2 that becomes 3/3 beside a Deploy gear. Fits decks full of battlefield gear.

name: Pillaged Armory
text: DEPLOY (Play this only to a battlefield. When an opponent holds here, kill this.) When you play this or when you conquer here, BUFF a friendly unit. (Give it a +1 might buff if it doesn't have one.)
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: A cheap Deploy gear that buffs a friendly unit when played and every time you conquer there. A Buff-deck engine.

name: Raving Witness
text: When I move, reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's MIGHTY, draw it. Otherwise, recycle it. (A unit is Mighty while it has 5+ might.)
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Each move digs for a Mighty unit. Works best in decks packed with big units.

name: Skystrike Squadron
text: You may return a friendly gear to its owner's hand as an additional cost to play me. If you do, I cost 2 less. DEFLECT (Opponents must pay 1 to choose me with a spell or ability.)
lore: Wiki: Demacian Silverwing riders bond with griffin-like raptors to scout ahead of armies, and Jarvan IV is one of the figures who can ride silverwings into battle.
translation: Return one of your gear to cut its cost by 2. Fits Deploy gear decks that can replay gear for value, such as Jarvan IV.

name: Sneaky Zeebles
text: When I conquer, ADD 1 power. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: A small conqueror that adds a Power rune, which can't be reacted to. Good ramp for decks that expect to win battlefields.

name: Avalanche
text: Deal 3 to all units in bases.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Hits every unit sitting in a base for 3, yours and theirs. A sweeper for units that haven't moved out.

name: Primordial Roar
text: ACTION (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) SHOW OFF a unit. (As you play this, you may reveal a unit from your hand or pick a friendly unit.) If you showed off a unit, deal damage equal to that unit's Might to a unit.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: Shows off a big unit to deal its might as damage. Excellent in Mighty and Buff decks.

name: Stalwart Goatherd
text: SHIELD 2 (+2 might while I'm a defender.) When you play me, you may kill a gear with Energy cost 4 or less.
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: A defender that can also remove an opposing gear with cost 4 or less. Handy against Deploy gear and Bomb decks.

name: Cataclysm
text: Opponents can't play spells this turn. Move a friendly unit to an occupied enemy battlefield. "For the King!" -Jarvan IV
lore: Quoted by Jarvan IV. Wiki: he is the only son of King Jarvan III and became king of Demacia after his father died in the Great Mage Rebellion.
translation: Shuts off the opponent's spells for the turn while you push a unit into their battlefield. A strong finishing tempo play.

name: Portable Portal
text: DEPLOY (Play this only to a battlefield. When an opponent holds here, kill this.) When you play this, you may pay 1 to ready a unit here. Friendly units here have GANKING. (They can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
lore: The art shows Teemo with his scout hat. Wiki: he is The Swift Scout who leads the Bandle Scouts. The card does not name him, so this is an art-based link.
translation: Readies a unit when played and lets friendly units there move battlefield to battlefield. A tempo gear for aggressive decks.

name: Staunch Survivor
text: ASSAULT 2, SHIELD 2. (+2 might while I'm an attacker or defender.)
lore: No direct League of Legends story is attached to this card. Not every Riftbound card is intertwined with the lore.
translation: A 2-cost unit that is 4 might both attacking and defending. Strong in Assault and Shield decks, the K'Sante lane.
